title: Signature Multiverse: The Possibility Garden

title: Signature Multiverse: The Echo Principle
description: Manon's echo principle proposes that similar initial conditions across hypothetical branches would produce similar observers — so the 'typical' observer's experience is robust across the ensemble. Its use is methodological: when reasoning about untestable ensembles, assume typicality and check what follows. A reasoning tool, labeled Signature concept.

title: Signature Multiverse: The Draft Review
description: Manon's draft review applies the draft-stack model to decisions: before a big choice, write the 'commit message' for each branch — what this choice means, what it costs, what it closes. title: Signature Multiverse: The Infinity Budget
description: Manon's infinity budget rations appeals to infinity: each theory gets a finite budget of infinities it may invoke, and must spend them where they buy predictions.
